title: Amalfi Coast Decorative Glass Bottle — Lemons & Flowers
body_html:
A little Amalfi. A feeling to keep.

Sea-blue views, sunlit lemons and flowers that never fade. This decorative glass bottle captures the warmth of the Italian coast in a piece you can hold, turn and treasure.

The front opens onto a colorful coastal scene. Turn it around for a blue-and-yellow Italian tile-inspired design, framed with dimensional lemons, green leaves, pink blossoms and deep burgundy flowers. Lavender floral details flow along the edges, finished with a lemon-yellow decorative stopper.

The piece

  • Glass bottle individually decorated by hand with decoupage art and painted dimensional details
  • Coastal artwork on the front, tile-inspired artwork on the reverse
  • Sculptural lemon and floral embellishments
  • Decorative stopper included
  • One finished piece available, shown from four angles
  • Handmade textures and small imperfections are part of its character

Ready to give

Your bottle arrives in a protective dust bag inside a gift box, ready to give. A little sunshine for an Italy lover, a housewarming gift, or a corner of your own home that could use a touch of the coast.

Display & care

For decorative display. Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth. Keep away from moisture and prolonged direct sunlight to protect the artwork and dimensional details.

Handmade by TRESORA. Keep this feeling.
